text: {"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'paibil' (first): the sick man sent first for his younger brother"], "added": ["\"may be made complete\""], "mistranslated": ["redemption of the captives (u lohul u chucanob) -> \"redemption of all others\"", "the younger brother speaks with great sorrow and tears -> sorrow and tears given to the sick man (\"overwhelmed by great sorrow, with tears streaming from his eyes\")", "remember you have already come through other, greater illnesses -> \"after you endure it, other and greater things will come\"", "speak the truth of your words and confess them -> \"sincerely pledge with your words to renounce them\"", "plainly resembling the two who had come before (chacan tiob layob catulob t maniebe) -> \"appearing clearly to both of them who were passing the night there\"", "his heart was opened -> \"words entered into the sick man's heart\" (minor)", "great hope (alabolal) -> \"great faith\" (minor)", "cut your days for what you did -> \"decreed it with good cause\" (minor)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["lolob lakilob (wicked companions) -> \"wicked pleasures\" (probable)", "Saint Bernard clause: 'laiti u ɔayatzil Dios' is made into a statement that the Holy Spirit is the mercy of God, a slightly forced reading"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gets the captives, the brother's tears, the earlier illnesses and the likeness to the two earlier visitors right, and A gets all four of these wrong."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ca tu Zitah: 'he departed' after speaking his warning"], "added": ["it is not far off"], "mistranslated": ["cħaaba bin tac û Kinil (take care, the day will come) -> 'But the day will surely come'", "tan apactic ù lobil à belob ca à hach okte à kebanob (so that you, seeing the evil of your ways, might weep for your sins) -> 'I have been watching your wicked ways, waiting for you to weep', which makes God the one watching", "tan úpactic û xotol û kin (awaiting the end of his days/life) -> 'watching for the rising of the sun'", "ù noc kixob (covering/crown of thorns) -> 'the marks of the lashes'", "tacitac û tuculic (he at once thought) -> 'whenever he thought of it'", "û pectzil (rumor/report) -> 'shame'", "tan Uiche (in your face) -> 'I only see'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["û cici tħan Dioz (the good word of God) -> 'the holy word of God'", "ma hakotzil (do not be astonished) -> 'Do not be afraid'", "ù noc kixob (covering/crown of thorns) -> 'a garment of thorns', which is too literal"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya closely, including the brother leaving, the purpose clause about the sun, moon and stars, the 'end of his days' and the thorns, while A misreads several of these and adds 'it is not far off'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["<gloss>Henry of Ghent</gloss> and the note claiming Henry of Ghent was known in Spanish tradition as 'Enrique Gran'. This identification is doubtful and probably false."], "mistranslated": ["û peec xan heklae (it moves too, so) -> 'and it stops moving as well'", "c Zihzalexe y tulacal bahũ baal mali yinac Caan y lume (as we were born; before all things, before heaven and earth existed) -> 'as we were created and as all things were. Before heaven and earth existed'", "ua ú yanal baal tan â culpachticeex hahal Dioz (or other things, and you turn your back on the true God) -> 'when you turn your backs on the true God for something else'", "û uaiazba hebal c tucliceex â hanonexe (an image of what you think about as you eat) -> 'delusions that come when we sleep'", "maix uchac û tabli yoklal topzazil utial tulacal baal (nor can He be deceived, because all things are clear to Him) -> 'it cannot deceive because He is supremely clear to all things'", "baibic minan yet ꝑiz û yutzile (His goodness has no equal) -> 'without measure' (small slip)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["Ɔocebali tun (finally): this opening word of the last paragraph is left out"], "added": ["'a little' in 'understand a little more'"], "mistranslated": ["c alicexe (we say) -> 'as you say'", "ma hebicx c yacunahexe (not like our love) -> 'not like your love'", "c Zihzalexe (as we were born) -> 'as you were born'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya more closely on the mirror image, dreams, and the claim that God cannot be deceived, slipping only on some pronouns; A gets several passages wrong and adds a doubtful identification of Enrique Gran as Henry of Ghent."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["yokol ú noh celembal (over/upon His great youthfulness) -> 'above His magnificent youthful form' (slightly loose)", "cu tzicob (shall be obeyed/honoured) -> 'obeyed, honored' (acceptable, slight rewording of the three verbs)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["shone", "the tears of"], "mistranslated": ["yokol ú noh celembal (upon his great youthfulness) -> 'upon his shoulder'", "y ú yabal Zakcil hebixten (and one of such great misery as I) -> 'with such great whiteness as this'", "ú alabolal ah Zatalob (hope of the lost) -> 'praise of the lost'", "ɔecec yalil in uichlae uchic in uoktic yn Keban (these few tears of my eyes with which I weep for my sin) -> 'this mark of blood on my face, which I received for my sin'", "caix hach Zahbentzil (though it was very fearsome) -> 'they are greatly to be revered'", "be uyum (O lord of) -> 'Lord, father of'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the Maya closely and accurately, while B gets several key passages wrong, most seriously turning the sinner's few tears into a 'mark of blood on my face' and putting the dove 'upon his shoulder'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Baxi ú nucul ta tuculeex (what do you think / what is your answer) -> 'What is the reason, in your consideration' (slightly recast as a question about cause)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["bin c yacunteex (we shall love [the Holy Spirit]) after 'the Holy Spirit'", "uꝑel ('only') in 'uꝑel mehen Dioz', the only Son of God"], "added": ["\"wished to\""], "mistranslated": ["caat emi (then he descended) -> 'Then the Son of God wished to come down'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both are close renderings, but B leaves out the opening 'we shall love [the Holy Spirit]' and the word 'only' for the Son, and adds 'wished to', while A is complete and accurate."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["see whether experience itself does not confirm it -> \"See now whether, if it is constantly delayed, it does not settle\"", "if out of custom they ask it to repeat its prayers at their proper times -> \"because of neglect they turn their backs on prayers of thanksgiving and devotions\"", "sin/shamelessness is born (cu chibil ... le mazubtalil) -> \"With each day shame is born\"", "so that it becomes ugly, loathsome and wicked -> \"because it is accompanied by what is hateful and wicked\"", "unless Jesus Christ called it at the very beginning -> \"unless they quickly call upon Jesus Christ\" (agent reversed)", "a red swelling (chac uyenil) -> \"gangrene\" (loose rendering)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the hands hang down, the eyes close, the ears do not hear the words (rendered as something else)"], "added": ["\"the glances of grace turned toward it\""], "mistranslated": ["the hands (kab) drop -> \"The inspirations that come to it\"", "the eyes close -> \"the glances of grace turned toward it\"", "the ears do not hear the words -> \"the words it no longer understands, though they are heard\"", "the worms of a rotten life swarm -> \"The pleasures of a wicked life increase\"", "nothing else is seen that shows signs of its former beauty -> \"Nothing else is seen in it but traces of the former beauty\" (sense reversed)", "how very difficult (olmail) -> \"how pitiful\" (twice)", "broke an arm (cach ... kab) -> \"received a wound\"", "you would soon regain health even if it cost much pain and time -> \"it would heal its pain and sickness\"", "it is loathed and rejected -> \"provokes anger and earns reproach\""]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gets the body imagery (hands, eyes, ears, worms, broken arm) and most of the argument right, with a few slips; B misreads several key nouns, reverses the 'signs of former beauty' clause and garbles the closing comparison."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["c tħilicƀaéex ti le ú kahualil Dios (we remain in enmity with God) -> 'we remain distant from the presence of God'", "iztic c luƀuléex (we fall easily/readily) -> 'we easily fall' is fine, but the weakness/obstinacy contrasts are paraphrased somewhat freely"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the contrasts of weakness vs. malice, temptation vs. contempt and frailty vs. free will are not translated; they are replaced by an approximate rendering marked unclear"], "added": ["\"because he wishes his great goodness and mercy to be honored\"", "\"and to Him, when He calls you to forgiveness without being heeded\""], "mistranslated": ["not only for the sinner's sake must the remedy for sin be applied quickly -> 'the sinner's rising becomes harder the longer the fall into sin lasts'", "if we call on Him quickly, He recognizes the fall comes from frailty -> 'he calls you at once'", "pushes aside the hand God extends to deliver him -> 'He hinders the good that God wished to do'", "losing the love of his God -> 'lost the strength of his God'", "so much more unworthy do we make ourselves before Him -> 'so many times you fail to do what is right toward him'", "so many extended hands -> 'so many further favors'", "that negligence and sloth in calling on the Pardoner -> 'when He calls you to forgiveness without being heeded'", "we urge you to call -> 'you must call'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gives the argument of the page accurately and in full, with only a slip on 'enmity with God', while B gets several key passages wrong, inserts content and leaves the central contrast passage approximate."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["quickly, when you truly know you have fallen into grave sin -> 'promptly, so that we truly understand that once we have fallen' (turns the time clause into a purpose clause)", "'ti zeƀchilah' (quickly/in haste, or as a warning) -> 'with urgency' (acceptable, but the sense is uncertain)", "the Gospel words 'cú nahmaticóob humpel hach pelelil ɔá uol' (bring on great dread/concern) -> 'deserve the most earnest attention' (doubtful)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["the idea of 'á zàat-zahul' (your forgiving) in 'teaching necessary for your forgiveness of us sinners', reduced to 'teaching for us sinners'"], "added": ["meta claim that the sentence begins with 'Sacrament' on the previous page (not verifiable from this page)"], "mistranslated": ["'tech à cici kaholmá' (you know well) -> 'you heard well'", "'yaƀóob hakoƀilóob caputcuxtalóob' (many marvellous resurrections) -> 'many sinners return to life'", "'cħa y á yuchucil zinil kaƀ' (stretch out your powerful hand) -> 'bring your power of forgiveness'", "'cà má unchacóoƀ ú helel tac ú caxtcechóob' (so they may not rest until they seek you) -> 'so that they do not delay their change until they come to seek you'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A keeps the meaning closely, including the outstretched hand, the wonderful resurrections and the 'no rest until they seek you' clause, while B gets several key phrases wrong (forgiveness power, sinners returning to life, delaying change)."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["The phrase \"kazil ɔilib\" is rendered here following Ripalda's Spanish, which speaks of giving good advice. (note asserts something false: kazil ɔilib means bad example)"], "mistranslated": ["yuntzilóob y palilóob (masters and servants) -> fathers with their children", "palilóob y yumtzilóob (servants and masters) -> children with their fathers", "tzicbenil (respect) -> peace", "Is there anything else belonging to killing? -> Is there any obligation toward others to keep them from death?", "táan ú ɔabal kazil ɔilib (giving bad example) -> by giving good counsel", "m atáan ú ɔabal antahul (not giving help) -> by giving help"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé (as [with] God's children) -> Just as God acts toward His children (slightly loose)", "what is it that it requires, namely not killing -> what does it completely forbid (minor shading)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "In B, masters and servants come out correctly as amos/criados, and so does the final answer on giving bad example and not giving help, while A misreads both and turns the last answer's meaning upside down."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["yumtzil iix ah yacunah (lord and lover) -> 'a loving lord and father'", "cà má c paymaéex kaholticéex (we do not first recognize it / fail to heed it) -> 'whom we do not first recognize' (relative clause attached to the Lord, a slight distortion)", "ti ú ɔiliƀ (in his writing/teaching) -> 'in his writing' is acceptable, but 'Ahzáat-zah zipiléex' as 'our' Forgiver loses the 2nd person plural 'your sins'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ti á ual (from your son) in the request to Mary", "nóhoch mummiailá (great affliction) whose sign is described"], "added": ["\"as you do\"", "\"as the prophecy says\""], "mistranslated": ["uol hach heɔáan cú cilƀa, iix cù xiƀil ú kikel (heart, terrified, trembles and blood curdles) -> 'as a thing most certainly to be seen, and blood will flow'", "tioklal leló ú tzecultóon y yaƀalóob nummiailóob (for this he punishes us with many afflictions) -> 'because it leads us astray, and the many evils that exist today foretell it'", "ah yacunah (lover) -> 'Strengthener'", "ú núuctenóob (answer me) -> 'receive it'", "inaix chucáanil cà ú tħanóob (how perfect are his words) -> 'though his words are few'", "ù nummia hach yaé (their grievous afflictions) -> 'his many mercies'", "tiƀilƀeilóob, iix nuculilóob hakoƀilóob (good things and wondrous teachings) -> 'reproaches and harsh prophecies'", "chucáanilóob (perfections) -> 'severe things'", "c ilicéex / puɔcóonéx (we see / let us flee) -> 'you see ... flee'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the Maya closely with only minor slips, while B repeatedly gets the sense wrong (punishment, perfections, good teachings) and adds unsupported phrases."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["'Ahzáat-zahuléex' / 'Ahzáat-zah zipiléex' (the -éex suffix suggests a second-person plural address, 'you ...') -> glossed as the Savior / 'our Forgiver of sins' acting as subject", "'Bay ti hun hatzul' (thus in one moment) -> 'In like manner, where they were seated'", "'má unchac ù macunzaƀal' (cannot be hidden) -> 'cannot be overlooked'", "'ti cá unchaci tioklal napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex' (so that you may be pricked in heart or come to recognise it) -> 'so that it may serve to correct what you already recognize'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'ah ƀolóob' (the sellers/dealers) in the first sentence", "'tancaƀ' (courtyard), flattened to 'out of the temple'"], "added": ["my children", "which is only fit to be called a den of thieves"], "mistranslated": ["'Ilaéex ƀehelé' (see ye now) -> 'You know well, my children'", "'tamanóob, le mehen uacxóob' (sheep, young oxen) -> 'oxen, little sheep'", "'halili lay cáach cú tiiltic yotochil okoltƀá' (which was meant only as a house of prayer) -> 'only fit to be called a den of thieves'", "'camƀezah ti c nuculil cuxtaléex' (this teaching applied to our way of life) -> 'the evils of our Christian life'", "'ti hach nohochil hatzul' (in the greater part [of your churches]) -> 'of very great moment'", "'Cóonéex tioklal hatzulilóob' (let us go by parts) -> 'Listen, for they are grave matters'", "'má á cici tuclicéex' (you do not think well) -> 'you never think'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and largely accurate apart from a doubtful reading of the Ahzáat-zah forms, while B swaps the animals, adds 'my children' and a 'den of thieves' that are not in the source, and misreads several key phrases, including the closing sentence."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["c meyahtbaóob (our working upon ourselves, i.e. mortifications/penances) -> 'our pious devotions'", "le xmá tiblil (idleness / lack of proper occupation, Ripalda's 'ociosidad') -> 'Bad conduct'", "le nuculóob kebané (the sinful things/thoughts) -> 'the occasions of sin' (slight shift)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["Mayli cú nahaltic: the point that the person rather gains merit"], "added": ["'if he does not take pleasure in them'"], "mistranslated": ["Mayli cú nahaltic (rather he merits) -> 'No, if he does not take pleasure in them'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A correctly says that someone who drives away bad thoughts gains merit, while B changes this into a condition about not taking pleasure in them; B's other wording, such as 'idleness' and 'works of penance', is closer than A's."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["notable", "worldly", "vain words"], "mistranslated": ["x má xulilóob (unending / without basis, of the gossip) -> 'endless vain words' (approximate)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["or the harm that they did"], "mistranslated": ["ɔocanacti ú tohpultic ú keban (is it enough to confess his sin) -> 'enter into the forgiveness of their sin'", "ú paxmá ti ú comiló (what he owes to its owner) -> 'what they have taken from their neighbor'", "x má xulilóob (unending / baseless) -> 'when they are untrue' (approximate)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gets the central question right (whether confessing the sin is enough), while B misreads it as entering forgiveness and also gets the restitution answer wrong, though A adds a few small words such as 'notable' and 'worldly'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["is it a sin to desire riches (for one's living/station) in a proper way -> 'other than for a good purpose' (reverses the sense of the question)", "why are there special (pelelil) commandments about the desires of the flesh and of riches -> 'why are the desires ... forbidden by these commandments'", "because their thoughts and desires can be evil -> 'from them arise evil thoughts and evil inclinations'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["so that the commandments of God may be made clearer (zazilcuntic, 'to illuminate/clarify') -> 'so that the commandments of God may be kept better'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya closely except where it renders zazilcuntic as 'kept better', while A reverses the sense of the first question and loosens the next exchange, though it does get 'make clearer' right."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["zut-zah yacunahóob (give back thanks / return for kindnesses) -> 'thanks in return of love' (slightly loose)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ti máax c paymá tulul tzic (to whom we owe foremost obedience/reverence)"], "added": ["the one we call the Holy Father", "you are told to hear", "for our sins"], "mistranslated": ["c paymá tulul tzic (whom we chiefly obey/revere) -> 'the one we call the Holy Father'", "Bahun ti ú yabal misa (since Mass is said) -> 'Since you are told to hear Mass'", "cú mentáal ti Cristo (made of Christ) -> 'made to Christ'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A stays close to the Maya throughout, while B replaces the reverence clause with 'Holy Father', calls the sacrifice one made 'to Christ', and adds 'hear' and 'for our sins'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["pa ꜭhavomariçabal hay ('in the house of purification', a gloss on Purgatory) -> 'or in the hospital'", "ru ꜫitahic hun vinak (likely the person's appointed time or hour) -> 'in visiting a person'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ra hilaxic paru vi (the reading of the Bull over him) in the first-occasion clause"], "added": ["Then also, when a person is gravely ill, he makes use of this Bull."], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhiri ga tu gunih vi ra hilaxic paru vi (there its reading over him can take effect) -> 'Then the absolution is fittingly granted to him'", "ꜭhiri ga tu nimacoꜭhih vi vinak... ꜭhiru bula (there the person receives the absolution through the Bull, in the confession made while healthy) -> 'when a person is gravely ill, he makes use of this Bull', which moves the remission of sins to the sickness occasion"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the source closely apart from rendering the Purgatory gloss as 'hospital', while B leaves out the reading-over clause and adds a false 'gravely ill' occasion, which misplaces the remission of sins."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ah ahil chi roꜫexic ronohel kamac (longing to weep over / lament all our sins) -> 'wanting to declare all our sins'", "tan ti giꜯ ruçach Padre Saçerdote (while the Father Priest is acting on or absolving us) -> 'before the Father Priest' (the sense is simplified and uncertain)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["and it is greatly to be honored, its presence"], "mistranslated": ["tu coꜭhih yi ru nima ho yeuaxic ru vaꜭh (he applies or bestows the great pardon before him) -> 'he shall take patience ... greatly to be honored, its presence'", "ki ti vagaxah chipe ru ꜭhoh mil vae (what is needed for this pardon to come) -> 'what you should hear concerning its proper benefit'", "vue ta ki ꜯih chi oh ah ghumum, ah ꜫatat gux (truly we must be humbled and contrite of heart) -> 'Even if truly we are proud, hard-hearted' (the sense is reversed)", "oh ta ga ah biꜯ (we should be sorrowful) -> 'or indeed songsters, merrymakers'", "chibiꜯ (with sorrow) -> 'with hymns'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gives the passage on contrition, confession and penance with only small slips, while B reverses the sense of the contrition passage (proud, hard-hearted, songsters) and garbles the opening clause."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'ꜫatatibal' (burning) of our heart is replaced by 'contrition/breaking'", "'paru ꜭhij' (from its hands/grasp) is left out; A renders it as a second 'place of burning'"], "added": ["\"from the place of burning\" (repeats the burning instead of rendering 'paru ꜭhij')"], "mistranslated": ["vꜯ ta ka banom ꜭhic ka Confesion, xax ti ka ban vij ka penitencia (if we have made our confession well, only then do we truly perform our penance) -> 'Although we have already made our confession, we must indeed still perform our penance'", "ꜭhiruꜫatatibal ga ka gux (with the burning of our heart) -> 'with the contrition <breaking> of our hearts'", "ꜭhirughumumibal (with crushing/grinding) -> 'with groaning'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["xa ha ti hal bex, ti gex va ꜭhi bex ... ꜭhiru pokonariçabal (eternal death is only exchanged/commuted into its punishment, its misery) -> 'changed and taken away, this eternal death, with its punishment and its misery' (the sense of commutation into a lesser punishment is blurred)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly reads the 'utz' clause about making a good confession and the 'crushing/burning of our heart' opening, while A misreads the confession clause as concessive and drops 'from its hands', although A handles the commutation at the end slightly better."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'kobe go he-ꜭhirij' (we go there still bearing our sins)", "the list of penance, fasting and mortification ('ku ꜯilah banoh, ka ꜯol ꜫomibal kij') is collapsed into 'good works'"], "added": ["wasting their days instead of making satisfaction for their sins", "it puts an end to this debt", "is immediately lightened"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhavomariçabal hay, house of cleansing/purification -> 'house of torment'", "how great its value, its power to save, the gift of the Holy Bull -> 'the Santa Bula is of the greatest importance... puts an end to this debt'", "however great a person's sin, if it has been paid for he will not go to pay it in Purgatory -> 'the punishment for a person's sins is immediately lightened'", "haga tan ti gamon vi lo[ꜫo]..., and if he should die -> 'And it is now received from this'", "the first-person plural 'we' of the opening is turned into a third-person 'someone/they'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["'our fasting and our mortification' for 'ku ꜯilah banoh, ka ꜯol ꜫomibal kij' is tentative and may not match these terms exactly"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Kaqchikel closely, getting 'house of cleansing', the value of the Bull, the clause 'however great the sin' and the ending 'if he should die', while A distorts several key clauses and adds material."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["caꜭhibal mac (remission of sins) is not translated; 'which are given' is put in its place"], "added": ["you must give your alms for it", "Therefore you must give your alms for it"], "mistranslated": ["pahuley, pahutaꜩ (in the pit, in the abyss) -> 'in the fire, in the burning'", "ca ca huna (every two years) -> 'each year'", "xa ca ca ꜭhihuna (only for two years) -> 'only year by year'", "cay ꜭhihuna (the two years) -> 'the year'", "tan tiya ꜭhivi (it is being given to you) -> 'you must give your alms for it'", "caꜭhibal mac (remission of sins) -> 'which are given'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["tiya ꜭhivi (it is given to you, plural) -> 'granted to them'", "ꜫobal (end of a word carried over from the previous page) -> read as a standalone word, 'ransom'", "vae tan tihath (this is being received/taken) -> 'currently offered'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly gives the two-year term of the Bull and the pit/abyss imagery of Purgatory, while A gets the period wrong, mistranslates the Purgatory phrase and adds a command to give alms that is not in the source."}
